_comment: Buildings (DT_Buildings). A new building row keeps the copied building's model and behaviour (its Blueprint, ScriptClass); a model or recipe list of its own needs a Blueprint (docs/examples/blueprints.md).

StoneProcessor._comment: A copy of the Processor: the same model, size, belt ports and recipes, with its own cost, name and description. ID 221 is in the 2xx group (active crafting machines); MyMachine uses 220.
StoneProcessor.DisplayDesc: A Processor built from Stone instead of Planks. Processes materials into components.

StoneProcessor._comment: Unlocks the Stone Processor: a copy of the Processor's research, in the row just below it, two columns right
